title: CRISPR-Cas9 Screen in Human Embryonic Stem Cells for Neural Differentiation
author: Qi, Sivakumar, et al.
materials: One Shot™ Stbl3™ Chemically Competent E. coli

The purpose of this step is to use high throughput sequencing to analyze all sgRNAs that are integrated in the genome. By comparing the distribution of sgRNAs in the unsorted and sorted NPCs, we can determine whether a given sgRNA is enriched or depleted in the target cell population.50.Check the size of DNA fragments with the Agilent Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity DNA Analysis Kit.51.Measure DNA concentration both by the Qubit dsDNA HS assay kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and by qPCR using the KAPA Library Quantification Kit (Roche) for Illumina platforms.52.Pool all samples and sequence on Illumina NextSeq 500 sequencer or other equivalent instrument with read configuration as 75-bp single-end sequencing. Sequence 20–30 million reads per sample.53.Analyze the sequencing data with the MAGeCK algorithm (Li et al., 2014).Note: The reference sgRNA library sequences for human GeCKO v2.0 (A and B) were downloaded from Addgene (https://www.addgene.org/pooled-library/). The clean sequence reads were mapped to the reference sgRNA library with mismatch option as 0 using MAGeCK. Read counts for each sgRNA were generated and median normalization was performed to adjust for library size. Positively and negatively selected sgRNAs and genes were identified with MAGeCK using the default parameters.

steps.title: Infect hESCs with GeCKO library
steps.instruction: Add the GeCKO v2 knockout library to wild‑type human embryonic stem cells (hESCs) and allow infection to occur as described in the source protocol.

steps.title: Select infected cells with puromycin
steps.instruction: Culture the infected hESCs in medium containing puromycin for 7 days to select for cells that have integrated the library.

steps.title: Differentiate selected hESCs into NPCs
steps.instruction: Replace puromycin medium with neural induction medium and culture the cells for an additional 7 days to obtain neural progenitor cells (NPCs; SOX1⁺, NESTIN⁺).

steps.title: Wash cells and prepare for staining
steps.instruction: Centrifuge NPCs in Perm‑III buffer for 10 min at 1,000 g; discard supernatant. Resuspend pellets in 30 mL cold PBS + 1 % BSA, centrifuge 10 min at 1,000 g, and repeat the wash once more. Finally, resuspend cells in 7 mL PBS + 1 % BSA and aliquot 50 µL each for an unstained control and a secondary‑antibody‑only control.

steps.title: Primary SOX1 antibody staining
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of SOX1 primary antibody (≈1:150 dilution) to the main cell suspension, mix, and incubate at room temperature (~26 °C) with rotation for 1 hour.

steps.title: Secondary antibody staining
steps.instruction: Wash the primary‑stained cells twice with PBS + 1 % BSA. Resuspend the cells in 7 mL PBS + 1 % BSA and add 15 µL of 488‑conjugated secondary antibody (≈1:500 dilution). For the secondary‑antibody‑only control, add 1 µL of the same secondary antibody to 450 µL PBS + 1 % BSA. Incubate both tubes at room temperature (~26 °C) with rotation for 1 hour, then wash each twice with PBS + 1 % BSA.

steps.title: Filter and count cell suspension
steps.instruction: Pass all cell suspensions through a 70‑µm cell strainer to remove debris, count the filtered cells, and set aside 3.6 × 10⁷ cells as the unsorted control for downstream NGS analysis.

steps.title: FACS sort SOX1‑negative NPCs
steps.instruction: Using the unstained and secondary‑antibody‑only samples as SOX1‑negative controls and the uninfected differentiated NPCs as a positive control, gate the NPC population on the sorter and collect the bottom 1 % of cells with the lowest SOX1 signal.

steps.title: Freeze sorted cell pellets
steps.instruction: Collect the sorted SOX1‑negative NPC cell pellets, flash‑freeze them in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C until DNA extraction.

steps.title: Check DNA fragment size
steps.instruction: Run the extracted DNA on an Agilent Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity DNA Analysis Kit to verify fragment size distribution.

steps.title: Quantify DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using both the Qubit dsDNA HS assay kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and qPCR with the KAPA Library Quantification Kit (Roche) for Illumina platforms.

steps.title: Pool libraries and sequence
steps.instruction: Pool all indexed libraries and sequence on an Illumina NextSeq 500 (or equivalent) using 75‑bp single‑end reads, targeting 20–30 million reads per sample.

steps.title: Analyze sequencing data with MAGeCK
steps.instruction: Download the human GeCKO v2.0 (A and B) reference sgRNA sequences from Addgene. Map clean reads to the reference with zero mismatches using MAGeCK, perform median normalization, and identify positively and negatively selected sgRNAs and genes using MAGeCK default parameters.

description: We adapted our CRISPR-Cas9 screening protocol from other published papers (Joung et al., 2017; Sanjana et al., 2014; Shalem et al., 2014). The overall screen strategy is outlined in Figure 1A. We used the GeCKO v2 knockout screening library that contained 6 unique sgRNAs to target all annotated genes in the human genome (Sanjana et al., 2014). Specifically, the library contained a total of 123,411 sgRNAs, which included sgRNAs targeting 19,050 genes, 2000 non-targeting control sgRNAs, and sgRNAs targeting 1,864 miRNAs. Using this library, we designed a CRISPR-Cas9 screen with an endpoint reporter to systemically identify genes required for NPC differentiation. Because CRISPR-Cas9 screens are expensive, labor intensive, and time consuming, it is critical to design effective screens with strong endpoints to ensure that the initial hits can be reproducibly validated.Figure 1Workflow of the CRISPR-Cas9 screen for regulators of NPC differentiation(A) Wild type hESCs (OCT4+, SOX2+) were infected with the GeCKO v2 library and selected with puromycin for 7 days. After selection, the hESCs were differentiated into NPCs (SOX1+, NESTIN+) by culturing in the neural induction medium for another 7 days and subjected to FACS sorting. The SOX1– cells were collected. Scale bar = 20 μm.(B) Experimental design of NPC staining and FACS sorting.
